'''''The Last of the Jedi: Underworld''''' is the third in a series of young reader novels that chronicle the adventures of [[Ferus Olin]] following [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].
